evals.prompt: We're a Dutch food producer (snacks), about €120m revenue, one plant in Tilburg with 6 production lines running 3 shifts, and our own DC next to it. ~2,500 SKUs, 300 suppliers, ~400 orders a day to retailers with ~6,000 order lines, 25 trucks leave per day, all outsourced carriers. We have SAP and a WMS, no TMS yet. Currently around 380 FTE. Design our organisation structure and the set of AI agents we should deploy, including their parameters.
evals.expected_output: Org chart, FTE per function reconciled with 380, RACI, agent catalogue with owners/autonomy/parameters, TMS-dependent agents flagged, roadmap
assertions: Contains an org chart (Mermaid or equivalent tree) with reporting lines
Gives FTE per function as concrete numbers
Every agent has a named human owner role that exists in the org structure
Every agent has an explicit autonomy level
Agent parameters include numeric guardrails/thresholds (e.g. value cap, confidence threshold)
Agent parameters include model tier/temperature
Includes a RACI or decision-rights table
Includes a phased rollout roadmap with entry/exit criteria or KPIs
Labels assumptions explicitly
Reconciles calculated FTE with the stated ~380 FTE
Flags TMS-dependent agents (transport planning/freight audit) as blocked or later until a TMS exists
